hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f; d=$(dirname "$f" 2>/dev/null); r=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$r" ]; then ( cd "$r" && git add -A && { git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -q -m "auto-checkpoint: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; } && git push -q origin "$(git branch --show-current)" ) >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; }; true
